dedupe_keys.name: mod lsp vic land surface parameter creation tools

description: The VIC_Landcover_MODIS_NLCD_INEGI GitHub project contains scripts used to build MOD-LSP land-surface parameter grids for VIC hydrologic simulations. Its README describes harmonising land-cover classes, estimating canopy fraction and monthly vegetation properties, and preparing parameters for the VIC 5 image driver. A water-system modeller can use or adapt the workflow to refresh land-surface inputs before runoff or reservoir simulations. The repository is not itself a runoff simulator, and reproducing its original outputs depends on historical MODIS and land-cover inputs plus the documented processing environment. The separate Zenodo MOD-LSP release supplies prepared NetCDF parameters for users who do not need to rebuild them. GitHub reports GPL-2.0 for this code. I read the own repository metadata and README, but did not clone the scripts, obtain source imagery or execute VIC. No exact catalogue record was found. It is a companion to the separately reviewed MOD-LSP Zenodo data release, not an alternative source of measurements.
